RC5 makes task-bound context routing usable from ordinary development entry points.

- A session-bound continuity task can supply the goal and source scope once. Normal routing and
  check preparation reuse that identity without guessing from recent activity or another worktree.
- Routing admits bounded, task-relevant source and document candidates before the coding model reads.
  It preserves required guidance, returns short source-linked excerpts, and keeps the originals
  available when the packet needs expansion. Candidate, omission and fallback reasons remain visible.
- `context-route` now gives explicitly named optional files the same 2 KiB default excerpt as
  discovered files. Oversized single lines can be omitted with a reason. Raise
  `--optional-excerpt-bytes` up to 64 KiB or read the original through `context` when needed.
- Optional JEV selection receives only approved, bounded evidence. It can rank relevant context;
  missing credentials, uncertainty, budget limits and provider failure keep deterministic delivery.
  The normal coding model remains fixed. The managed host guidance calls for one coding agent by
  default, and installation doctor detects missing or stale managed guidance.
- Legacy and expanded DL03 context questions remain separate configuration choices during this RC.
  They have different ranking and excerpt behavior, so compare their receipts by question version.

This release does not prove that an installed agent actually routes before reading, nor that it
saves tokens or time on accepted work. Adoption must check real task bindings, route receipts,
additional reads and outcomes. Host-native delegation outside governed admission remains a host
configuration concern.

After upgrading from RC4, refresh the managed host block: review
`project-governance host-instructions --dry-run`, then apply its `--plan-digest`. Doctor will flag
host-instruction drift until that step is complete; preserve any project-authored text around the
managed block.
